meta.title: Hearthline — Remote tech support for your home
meta.description: A certified technician fixes your computer over a secure remote connection, while you watch. Free diagnostic, 24/7, since 2014.

hero.lead: We fix slow computers, clear out viruses, set up your printer and rescue your files over a secure remote connection. You stay in your chair; we work on your screen while you watch.
hero.trustBadge: 100% refund if we can't fix it

trust.officesTitle: Offices in North America and Europe
trust.officesBody: Support in English, French, German, Spanish and Dutch, by phone, chat or email.
trust.unlimitedBody: One plan covers every call, every household device, as often as you need us.
trust.platformsTitle: Mac and Windows, all of it
trust.platformsBody: Laptops, desktops, printers, routers and the peripherals hanging off them.
trust.supportBody: About fifty certified staff, every day of the year, holidays included.

services.title: Everything that usually needs a shop visit
services.lead: Each session starts with a free diagnostic. The technician tells you what is wrong, what it takes to fix, and does it while you watch.
services.cleanupBody: Junk files removed, recurring alerts silenced, system and software updates applied. The slowdowns go away.
services.protectionBody: We install and configure a shield that blocks malicious sites before they load, then check it on your browsers.
services.tuneupBody: Regular tuning keeps a machine fast and safe. Quick scheduled visits, no waiting for something to break.
services.networkBody: Wi-Fi that reaches the whole house, set up and locked down against intrusion.
services.virusBody: Full diagnostic, every malware threat cleaned out, and a check that nothing came back next visit.
services.accessoriesBody: Printers, keyboards, mice, monitors, cameras — configured and kept on current drivers.
services.crashesBody: A crash looks alarming and rarely is. We trace the cause, explain it plainly and resolve it.
services.backupBody: Photos, documents and media copied somewhere safe, on a schedule that runs without you.
services.gamingBody: Settings, drivers and thermals tuned so the frames stay where they belong.
services.softwareBody: Installations, activations and the awkward ones — missing DLLs, licence conflicts, failed updates.
services.deviceStripAlt: Laptop, printer, router and accessories laid out together
services.deviceStripTitle: If it plugs in, we probably cover it
services.deviceStripBody: Laptops and desktops, printers and scanners, routers and mesh Wi-Fi, monitors, webcams, external drives. One technician, every device in the house, one visit.
services.group1Body: The everyday slowdowns, freezes and crashes that make a working machine feel past it.
services.group2Body: Protection that actually stays on, and a copy of everything that matters if the worst happens.
services.group3Body: The devices, connections and installs that never quite went to plan.

fixScrub.title: From cluttered to clear, on your own screen
fixScrub.step1Note: Old installers, duplicate downloads and years of cached junk. Nothing you actually use gets touched.
fixScrub.step2Note: We show you what each hidden process was doing, then switch off only the ones you agree to.
fixScrub.step3Note: Real-time protection back on, and the scam sites your browser was quietly letting through are blocked.
fixScrub.step4Note: Toolbars, coupon finders, and three add-ons that were reading every single page you opened.

testimonial.imageAlt: A technician with a headset working through a remote support session
testimonial.quote: They called back at eleven at night, took twenty minutes, and explained every step to my mother instead of to me.
testimonial.caption: — D. Marchand, customer since 2019

how.title: Three steps, one phone call
how.step1Title: Call, and talk to a person
how.step1Body: No ticket queue. Describe the problem in your own words and a technician picks it up on the same call.
how.step2Body: You get a one-time code and grant access yourself. The session is encrypted, visible on your screen, and ends when you close it.
how.step3Body: Free diagnostic first, then the repair, narrated as it happens. You keep a written summary of what changed.

about.title: A support desk that behaves like a neighbour
about.body1: Hearthline has looked after home computers since 2014. About fifty certified technicians run diagnostics, decide what actually needs removing, and fix it — from a stubborn software bug to an infected machine.
about.body2: The goal is unglamorous: a simple alternative to unplugging everything and driving to a shop, at a standard of work you would expect from one. Offices in North America and Europe; support in five languages.
about.imageAlt: A living-room side table with a laptop, reading glasses and a telephone

plans.title: Pay for a fix, or stop worrying about them
plans.subtitle: Choose the plan that fits your household. Change or cancel anytime.

cta.title: Start with the free diagnostic
cta.body: Tell us what the computer is doing. A technician calls you back, usually within the hour, and tells you plainly whether it is worth fixing.
cta.success: Thanks — a technician will call you back shortly.
cta.error: Something went wrong — call us instead at 1-888-402-7714.

footer.tagline: Remote technical support for homes, in North America and Europe.

checkout.title: Confirm your plan
checkout.lead: Tell us how to reach you, then pay by card or have a technician call you back.
checkout.methodLegend: How would you like to do this?
checkout.methodCardHint: Set up straight away, then we call to get you running.
checkout.methodCallbackHint: We ring within one business day and take payment on the call.
checkout.reassurance: We'll call within one business day. Payment is arranged on that call — nothing is charged now.
checkout.reassuranceCard: You'll see a summary before anything is charged.
checkout.referenceHint: Keep this handy — quote it if you call us about this order.
checkout.successBody: Thank you. A technician will call you within one business day to book your session and arrange payment.
checkout.error: Something went wrong placing that order. Please try again, or call us.
